item.title: SoFi Stadium workers vote to authorize strike ahead of World Cup
item.description: Negotiations between the union representing the workers, the hospitality group at the Los Angeles stadium and FIFA are set to continue Monday.

item.title: North Korean leader Kim showcases new warship ahead of visit by China's Xi
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un observed sea trials of a new warship repaired after a failed launch last year and vowed to accelerate efforts to build a nuclear-armed navy, state media said Saturday, showcasing his expanding military capabilities ahead...
